pairs.subject: background-jobs
pairs.evidence: features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:440 The ingest health roster is built only from sources that appear in the returned run history. A source with a declared cadence in LOOP_CADENCE_DAYS but no rows in the 500-run window (getLoopState.ts:34/50) drops off the surface instead of showing up as silent, so 'did not run' becomes invisible rather than a distinct signal.

techniques.evidence: features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:440 The roster comes from evidence, not from the declared cadence map, so silence detection cannot fire for a source that never ran or fell outside the window. Separately, rowsWritten (line 152) is carried in but never read, so an ok run with 0 rows renders 'v pořádku' and succeeded-empty is not separated from succeeded. The parts that do conform: failure streak (line 465), lastOkFinishedAt, and staleness against a declared cadence.

features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:4 A pure derivation over persisted run records. The context hosts no loop, timer or registration door. A grep of features/admin for setInterval/setTimeout returned nothing.
features/admin/loops/getLoopState.ts:1 A per-request read shell with no tick bodies. Crash capture, re-entrancy and per-tick deadlines belong to the ingest runtime, which lives outside this context.
features/admin/loops/getLoopState.ts:1 No server loop and no client poller. A grep for setInterval|setTimeout|visibilitychange|poll|router.refresh in features/admin returned zero hits.
features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:4 No loop here creates the state readers depend on, so there is no start for a first tick to gate.
features/admin/loops/getLoopState.ts:1 No background runtime start. Loader failures degrade to [] through reportLoaderFailure.
features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:4 No tracked operation and no bounded wait on one in this context.
features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:1 No recurring tick logs here. Alerts get state-fingerprint ids for acks, which is a separate mechanism from change logging.

pairs.registryProposal: loop-health-telemetry assumes the health surface sits next to the supervisor's registration. It should state how to apply when the observer is a separate read surface over persisted run records: the roster must be the declared-cadence set left-joined with run evidence, and a bounded history window must not be allowed to silently remove a loop.
